heading: Wednesday, September 3, 2025
topLine: Mathematicians use GPT-5 to derive quantitative fourth-moment convergence rates.

items.headline: Mathematicians use GPT-5 to derive quantitative fourth-moment convergence rates
items.summary: Charles-Philippe Diez, Luis da Maia and Ivan Nourdin ran a controlled experiment in which GPT-5 was asked to turn a qualitative fourth-moment theorem into a quantitative one with explicit convergence rates, in both the Gaussian and Poisson settings. The authors say such rates had not been addressed in the literature. They report that GPT-5 produced the results under continuous human guidance and correction, and that the authors checked them. The arXiv preprint has not been peer-reviewed.
